content: Jesos ka abidjibadj
8ibadj e kijeba8acinig e manadjitagani8anig, ik8e8ag ki ija8ag 8ibabikiniganikag. Pimide ka minomag8anig ogi iji8idona8a kagi ojito8agobanen.
Ogi mika8a8an dac kitci asinin 8asag 8edi egi taditibinagani8indjin ka odji pidigani8anig.
Midac ka iji pidige8adj. Ka8in dac ododji mikasina8a Jesosan o8ia8ini.
Meg8adj e taji mamidonendamo8adj adi ka ijisenig, kitata ogi 8abama8an nijin naben e kitci 8asigitenigin okonasi8an.
Ki onijik8ebanio8ag, ka apitci segizi8adj. Ogi igo8an dac ini naben: “8egonen 8edji iji nanada 8abameg ka nibo8adj ka iji te8adj aa8e ka pimadizidj?
Ka8in aja ooma tesi. Ki abidjiba nibo8inikag. Mika8iok adi kagi ikidopan meg8adj kiabadj Galilee akikag ka paba tepan.

Mi oo8e ekidopan: ‘Panima Ka pi Anicinabe8iidizodj ki pagidenimagani8idj kidji tibenimigodjin ka patadindjin a8iagon, acitc ki acidak8a8agani8idj tcibaiatigokag, acitc ki abidjibadj ki nisogonaganig,’ ” mi ka igo8adjin ini naben.
Ki odji mika8i8ag dac adi Jesosan ka ikidonipanin.
Ogi nagadana8a dac 8ibabikinigani, acitc ki koki ki8e8ag kidji nda 8idama8a8adjin ini ka midatcin acitc pejigondjin Jesosan Odanodagani acitc kodagian a8iagon kagi nosone8anipanin Jesosan.
Mani Magdala, Jo8ana (Jeanne), acitc Mani, 8in Jak (Jacques) odjodjoman, acitc kodagiag ik8e8ag kagi 8idjiogo8agobanen, mi igi8e ik8e8ag kagi nda 8a8idama8a8agobanen Jesosan Odanodaganan.
Igi dac Anodaganag “ka8in teb8esi8ag” inendamo8agoban, ka8in dac ododji teb8eta8asi8a8an.

[Misa8adj dac Pien ki pazig8idjise, acitc dac ki ipato 8ibabikiniganikag. Ki camagi e podazig8eabadag 8ibabikinigani. Ogi mikanan dac 8ik8eiginiganan eta. Midac ka iji koki ki8edj, e kitci mamakadendag adi ka iji8ebanig.]
Imeos (Emmaüs) mikanakag
Mi pejig8an ii e kijigag, nijin nabeg ka paba nosone8a8agobanen ako Jesosan ija8agoban odenajicikag, Imeos (Emmaüs) ka ijinikadenig, 8aiej nij8asotibaigan ka apisinag8anigobanen Jerusalemikag.
Omikodana8agoban kakina ka pi iji8ebanigobanen.
Meg8adj e pimi aiamiidi8adj, Jesos ogi nazika8an acitc ogi pimi 8idji8an.
O8abama8agoban, pekic dac ka8in ododji nisida8ina8asi8a8an.
Jesos dac ogi k8ag8edjiman: “8egonen mekodameg meg8adj e pimoseieg?” Midac ka iji kibisika8adj, kitci kackendamobanig mega.
Pejig aa8e e niji8adj, Kleopas (Cléopas) ka ijinikazodj, ogi inan: “Kin na eta ooma Jerusalemikag ka8in kidodji nodagesi adi ka iji8ebag?”

Jesos ogi inan: “Adi ka iji8ebag?” Ki inagani8i dac: “8adan ka ijisedj Jesos, Nazaret ka odjidj. Kitci macka8i niganadjimo8inni8iban, ka kitci mamada8izidj acitc ka sogigij8edj, ka min8enimigopanin Kije Manidon acitc kakina a8iagon.
Nikitci aiamie ogimaminanag acitc nidogimaminanag ogi pagidenima8an kidji nisimagani8indjin. Ki acidak8a8agani8i dac tcibaiatigokag.
Nina8it dac, nidinendananaban mi aa8e Kije Manidon kagi pidjinijaogodjin kidji pi nda ag8acimadjin Israel a8iagon. Ogajigag dac aja nisogon ka ako iji8ebag ii.
Nandam ik8e8ag ka 8idjiogo8ag, nigi kitci mamakadendamiigonanag. 8ibabikiniganikag ki ija8ag kitci 8ibadj ka kijeba8acinig.
Ka8in dac ododji mikasina8a Jesosan o8ia8ini. Ki koki pi ki8e8ag dac e pi tibadjimo8adj ajenin egi 8abama8adjin, egi igo8adjin: ‘Pimadizi Jesos.’
Nandam ii e taciag ki ija8ag 8ibabikiniganikag, ogi 8abadana8a dac e teb8endjin ini ik8e8an. Ka8in dac ododji 8abamasi8a8an Jesosan.”
Jesos dac ogi inan: “Ka8in odji pejig kinisidotasina8a! Kikitci ninamizim kidji teb8etameg adi ka pi iji tibadjimo8adj niganadjimo8innig.
Mi panima iidi ka inendagozigobanen kidji iji kodagitodj aa8e Kije Manidon kagi ikidonipanin kidji pidjinijaogodjin, kidji gi minigodjin Kije Manidon odicpendagozi8ini.”
Jesos dac ogi 8a8idama8an adi ekidomaganig Kije Manidon Omazinaigani 8in e mikomagani8idj. Moisan omazinaiganikag ki odji madjita. Mina8adj dac niganadjimo8innin kakina omazinaigani ogi mikodanan.
Apitc ka ani oditamo8adj pecodj odenajicini taji ka ija8apan, mi maia kiabadj ka 8i ani madjadj e todagiban Jesos.
Ogi midjimina8an dac e ina8adjin: “Mi ooma iji niban. Aja ani onag8icin acitc aja kegat kada tibikan.” Midac Jesos ka iji pidigedj kidji 8idji tajikemadjin.
Apitc ka onabidj 8isini8aganikag kidji 8idji 8isinimadjin, ogi odapinan pak8ejiganan, mig8etc ogi inan Kije Manidon, midac ka iji papak8ebinadjin ini pak8ejiganan acitc ka iji minadjin.
Ki minagani8i8ag dac kidji nisida8ina8a8adjin. Kaiezigotc dac Jesos ka8in odji nagozisi.
Ki inidi8ag dac: “Mi maia ickode ka taji piskaneg pidigamig kina8itinakag enenimo8akoban meg8adj e pimi aiamiigo8ak, acitc e mikodamago8ak Kije Manidon Omazinaigani.”

Teci8ag ki pazig8i8ag acitc ki koki ki8e8ag Jerusalem odenag. Iima dac ogi mika8a8an e ma8adjiidindjin ka midatcin acitc pejigondjin Jesosan okikinoamaganan acitc kodagian a8iagon kagi nosone8anipanin Jesosan.
Ki inagani8i8ag dac igi8e nijin nabeg: “Teb8e Jesos ka Tibendjigedj ki abidjiba! Ogi toda8an Simon kidji 8abamigodjin.”
Ke8ina8a dac ki tatibadjimo8ag adi ka pi iji8ebanig meg8adj e pimode8adj, acitc adi kagi odji nisida8ina8a8adjin Jesosan apitc ka papak8ebinandjin pak8ejiganan.
Jesos o8abamigon okikinoamaganan
Meg8adj e taji tatibadjimo8adj, kitata Jesos iima ki odji nagozi, e tajigaba8idj nena8idj 8ina8akag. Ogi inan: “Pekadendamo8in kimininom.”
Ki kitci kock8endamo8agoban acitc ki kitci segizi8agoban. “Tcibai ni8abamanan,” inendamo8agoban.
Jesos dac ogi inan: “8egonen 8edji migockadendameg? 8egonen 8edji ega teb8etameg?
Kana8abadamokon ninidjin acitc nizidan. Nin oo maia. Taginicik acitc 8abadamok. Ka8in tcibai o8ia8isi acitc ka8in okani8isi. Ki8abamijim dac e o8ia8ian.”
Ka ick8a ikidodj ii, ogi 8abadaan onidjin acitc ozidan.
Kikinoamaganag dac ki kitci min8endamo8agoban acitc ki kitci mamakadendamo8agoban. Ka8in dac maci maia oteb8eta8asi8a8abanin. Jesos dac ogi inan: “Kidaiana8a na ooma kegon kidji midjigadeg?”
Ogi mina8an dac pejigonejigan kigozan e sasondjin.
Jesos ogi odapinan acitc ogi am8an, meg8adj e kijigabamigodjin.

Jesos dac ogi inan: “Meg8adj ka 8idji tajikeminagogiban, kigi 8idamonom: ‘Nimikomigo Mois omazinaiganikag, niganadjimo8innig omazinaigani8akag acitc 8eckadj Kitci Aiamie Nigamo8inikag. Panima dac kada iji8eban kakina ka mazinadeg.’ ”
Ogi minan dac kidji nisidotamindjin Kije Manidon Omazinaigani.
Ogi inan: “Mi oo mezinadenig: ‘Aa8e Kije Manidon kagi ikidonipanin kidji pidjinijaogodjin kada kodagito, midac kada abidjiba ki nisogonaganig.

Panima ki mikomagani8idj e paba kagik8ani8anig taji ka tajike8adj a8iagog kakinagotc ka inakanezi8adj, Jerusalemikag dac kada odji madjitani8an. Panima ki 8idama8agani8i8adj a8iagog kidji an8endizo8adj acitc kidji kasiama8agani8i8adj opatado8ini8an.’ Mi mezinadenig.
Kigi 8abadana8a adi ka iji8ebag, acitc kidinendagozim kidji paba 8idama8eg8a a8iagog.
Nin dac kiga pidjinijaamonom ii8eni Nidadam kagi ikidodj kidji minigo8eg. Panima dac ki tajikeieg ooma odenakag, pinici kidji odisigo8eg macka8izi8in 8ak8ig ka odjimagag.”
Jesos 8ak8ig ka icpikagobanen
Kegapitc dac Jesos ogi iji8inan okikinoamaganan ag8adjik odenakag pinici Betani (Béthanie) odenakag, midac iima ka iji icpiniketadj kidji aiamit8anadjin okikinoamaganan.
Meg8adj e taji aiamit8anadjin, ogi naganan, 8ak8ig e ani icpikadj.
Kikinoamaganag dac ogi kitci icpenima8an Jesosan. Ki koki ki8e8ag Jerusalemikag e kitci min8endamo8adj.
Apan acitc ki tajike8agoban Coda8inni kitci aiamiemigi8amikag kidji icpenima8adjin Kije Manidon.
